strongest_mundane_explanation: IQL's value functional reduces in closed form to the target-layer Gini split |D|^2 - sum_p |D_p|^2, which is exactly 0 on any intervention that cannot split the target partition. The nuisance interventions are causally isolated by construction, so they have value 0 to IQL and value 2^u - 1 to a criterion that scores the record. The whole separation is therefore one line of arithmetic: a criterion scoring the OBSERVATION buys residual bits that the obligation never reads, and a criterion scoring the TARGET does not. This is Bayesian experimental design with the utility function pointed at the target quotient instead of the observable - a parent with a different utility, not a new machine.
strongest_parent_explanation: Codex F4's property vector (F4.1 explicit alias representation, F4.2 legal intervention generator, F4.3 target-ambiguity-per-burden choice, F4.4 evidence update, F4.5 abstain rule) executed at scope: every element is realizable inside decision-theoretic experimental design by choosing the target quotient as the utility. mechanism_attribution: The advantage enters through exactly one channel: interventions whose records carry resolvable bits that the serving obligation never reads. Remove those bits and keep the aliasing (ALIAS_NORESID) and the advantage vanishes exactly - not approximately - in 56 of 56 combinations. Remove the aliasing and keep the bits (NOALIAS_RESID) and every row spends 0 interventions. Budget is the second channel: the parent's wasted nuisance interventions matter only while the budget cannot absorb them, and PRED_UNCERTAINTY recovers to 16/16 at B = 7 when it can. The negative twin isolates the ambiguity measure itself: replacing it with a constant costs 4 of 16 orientations at B = 3 in every column.
new_invariant_learned: At scope: target-quotient valuation and predictive-uncertainty valuation are EXACTLY equal - identical interventions, identical burden, identical charged total - whenever the prediction-target residual is empty, EVEN WHERE observations alias the target 16-fold. Observational aliasing is therefore not the coordinate that separates the two criteria; the separation is carried entirely by observable, resolvable structure lying outside the serving obligation. strongest_mundane_explanation: SCDI is a cache keyed by price vector in front of a compiler that already exists. Its per-switch cost is the cycle mean of min(table, interpretation) and every fixed form's is the cycle mean of one of them, so the crossover is the ordinary amortization ratio (extra description and compile work) / (per-switch serving saving) - the L4 compile-amortization law of RV-377-033 and RV-377-038 with the price-switch count substituted for the reuse horizon. Nothing in the executed frontier requires a machine that is not a compiler plus a cache plus a price probe, and the exact developmental equality of clause 2 is the proof: every row serves the same answers, so the only thing at issue is cost.

mechanism_attribution: Three separable channels. TRANSFER: the shared authority state is what makes regimes B, C and D answerable at all (RETRAIN 0.0 / 0.7083 / 0.0 against 1.0), and it is worth everything - it decides admissibility, not cost. COMPILATION: worth exactly nothing semantically - all five authority-keeping rows emit bit-identical answers in all 40 groups - and worth a per-query cost that is column-dependent, TABLE winning only in B2. PRICE RESPONSE: the only channel that moves the frontier, and it moves it through the B0 scan-store column, where a fixed table's per-query cost grows linearly with the number of regimes materialized (54.125 -> 342.125) while an interpreter's does not. Removing the price response alone, with the compiler and the multiple morphologies left intact, costs the form its frontier from K = 4.85 to 6.33.
new_invariant_learned: At scope: compiled serving realizations are exactly semantics-preserving - five organizations, four columns, four G values, bit-identical answers in all 40 groups at capability 1.0 - so the entire F6 question is a cost question and can be settled by an affine cost model. Shared authority pays only when something actually recompiles.
